summary: Agilent Technologies filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a $600 million private placement of 4.900% Senior Notes due 2032. The notes were issued at 99.968% of par, mature January 15, 2032, and are senior unsecured obligations ranking equally with existing unsubordinated debt. The offering was made to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A and to non-U.S. persons under Regulation S. This is a routine debt financing; there is no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring.
